pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddho kosalesu janapadesu sāvatthiṃ gacchanto sāyaṃ aññataraṃ gāmaṃ upagañchi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena tasmiṃ gāmake aññatarissā itthiyā āvasathāgāraṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.4: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho yena sā itthi tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etadavoca: “sace te bhagini agaru vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāreti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.6: aññepi addhikā yena sā itthi tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etadavocuṃ: “sace te ayye agaru vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāreti”.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.7: eso kho ayyo samaṇo paṭhamaṃ upagato, sace so anujānāti vaseyyāthāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.8: atha kho te addhikā yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavocuṃ: “sace te bhante agaru vaseyyāma ekarattaṃ āvasathāgāre”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.10: atha kho sā itthi āyasmante anuruddhe sahadassanena paṭibaddhacittā ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.11: atha kho sā itthi yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca: “ayyo bhante imehi manussehi ākiṇṇo na phāsu viharissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.12: sādhāhaṃ bhante ayyassa mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññapeyyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.14: atha kho sā itthi āyasmato anuruddhassa mañcakaṃ abbhantaraṃ paññapetvā alaṅkatappaṭiyattā gandhagandhinī yenāyasmā anuruddho tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.15: “ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko ahañcamhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.17: evaṃ vutte āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.19: tatiyampi kho sā itthi āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.20: “ayyo bhante abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko, ahañcamhi abhirūpā dassanīyā pāsādikā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.21: sādhu bhante ayyo mañceva paṭicchatu, sabbañca sāpateyya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.22: tatiyampi kho āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.23: atha kho sā itthi sāṭakaṃ nikkhipitvā āyasmato anuruddhassa purato caṅkamatipi tiṭṭhatipi nisīdatipi seyyampi kappeti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.24: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho indriyāni okkhipitvā taṃ itthiṃ neva olokesi napi ālapi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.25: atha kho sā itthi “acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.26: bahū me manussā satenapi sahassenapi pahiṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.27: ayaṃ pana samaṇo mayā sāmaṃ yāciyamāno na icchati mañceva paṭicchituṃ sabbañca sāpateyya”nti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.28: sāṭakaṃ nivāsetvā āyasmato anuruddhassa pādesu sirasā nipatitvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.29: “accayo maṃ bhante accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yāhaṃ evamakāsiṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.30: tassā me bhante ayyo accayaṃ accayato patigaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.31: “taggha taṃ bhagini accayo accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ yā tvaṃ evamakāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.32: yato ca kho tvaṃ bhagini accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikarosi, taṃ te mayaṃ patigaṇhāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.33: vuddhi hesā bhagini ariyassa vinaye yo accayaṃ accayato disvā yathādhammaṃ paṭikaroti āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.34: atha kho sā itthi tassā rattiyā accayena āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappetvā sampavāretvā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.35: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ itthiṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.36: atha kho sā itthi āyasmatā anuruddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassitā samādapitā samuttejitā sampahaṃsitā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.38: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.39: evamevaṃ ayyena anuruddhena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.40: esāhaṃ bhante taṃ bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.41: upāsikaṃ maṃ ayyo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.42: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho sāvatthiṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.43: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.44: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā anuruddho mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappessatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.45: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.46: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ anuruddha mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.48: vigarahi buddho bhagavā. …pe… kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ anuruddha mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappessasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.50: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:1.51.1: “yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena sahaseyyaṃ kappeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.6: manussitthi, na yakkhī na petī, na tiracchānagatā, antamaso tadahujātāpi dārikā pageva mahattari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.13: mātugāme nipanne bhikkhu nipajjati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.1.14: bhikkhu nipanne mātugāmo nipajjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.1: mātugāme mātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.2: mātugāme vematiko sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.3: mātugāme amātugāmasaññī sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc6:2.2.5: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatitthiyā vā sahaseyyaṃ kappeti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
